chunks: ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman whose husband died before consummating the marriage. He said:

She is entitled to inheritance, and she must observe the complete waiting period. If he had specified a dowry for her, then she is entitled to half of it; and if he had not specified a dowry for her, then she is entitled to nothing.

key_terms.الْعِدَّةُ: the mandatory waiting period observed after the husband’s death
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثُ: the wife’s legal share of inheritance from her deceased husband
key_terms.فَلَا شَيْءَ لَهَا: she is entitled to no dowry when none had been specified
key_terms.كَامِلَةً: in full, meaning the complete prescribed waiting period
key_terms.مَهْرًا: the bridal dowry specified in the marriage contract

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a woman whose husband dies before consummation regarding inheritance, ʿiddah, and mahr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman whose husband dies before consummation. It states that she inherits from him and must complete the full ʿiddah of death, while her mahr is half if it had been specified and nothing if it had not been specified.
